title: On the dot: Meaning and Examples — Word Power 28

## On the dot

**Word Power 28 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Exactly on time or at the time mentioned.

### Usage

1. I'll meet you at 12 on the dot. Don't forget.
2. Breakfast is served at 8 on the dot.
3. The taxi showed up on the dot.

### How to use it

On the dot stresses an exact time. It commonly follows a clock time such as six or half past nine. 'At six' states the time; 'at six on the dot' emphasises punctuality.

### Another example

The bell rang at ten on the dot, and everyone opened their books.

### Check your understanding

Complete: Please be ready at eight ___ the dot. (on / in)

### Suggested answer

On. The expression means exactly eight, rather than approximately eight or just before eight.
